name: Shelbyville (United States)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city emblem: a blue map of Indiana bearing a courthouse tower, flanked by two yellow bears, within red and blue ribbons reading SHELBYVILLE and PRIDE IN PROGRESS.
history: Shelbyville is a city in Addison Township, Shelby County, in Indiana and is the county seat.

features.role: city emblem, a blue map of Indiana with a courthouse tower between two yellow bears, in a ring reading SHELBYVILLE PRIDE IN PROGRESS
